page.overview:
Who is Anni Aughta?

() is an uniya musician living in the Krook House in the Core Spire of Jrusar. As an NPC, Anni is played by Matthew Mercer.

Anni appears young and wears rough clothing.

Anni is somewhat crusty but benign; she expresses mild impatience with other members of the Krook House for not bringing in income, and she does not enjoy Fresh Cut Grass's bright, friendly encouragement or appreciate Ashton Greymoore saying they believe in her. Her normal attitude is somewhat "devil-may-care".

As Ashton and FCG left the Krook House on the day they met the rest of the group later named Bells Hells, Anni greeted them. She was practicing a new, fine-looking lute of uncertain provenance, hoping to pull something together for an audition at Stuvan's Dreamscape Theater.
